name: mfe-upgrade-poc
description: React 16 to React 19 migration POC using Webpack 5 Module Federation (Part 1 baseline)

scripts.start: concurrently -n container,app1,app2,app3 -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run start -w container-app" "npm run start -w mfe-app-1" "npm run start -w mfe-app-2" "npm run start -w mfe-app-3"
scripts.build:stats: npm run build:stats --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/collect-build-stats.js --out docs/performance-option-b.md --title "Performance — Option B (separate share scopes)"
scripts.preview: concurrently -n container,app1,app2,app3 -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run preview -w container-app" "npm run preview -w mfe-app-1" "npm run preview -w mfe-app-2" "npm run preview -w mfe-app-3"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:react16 && npm run test:unit:app1
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && playwright test --config tests/integration/playwright.config.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: jest --config tests/unit/jest.config.js --coverage && npm run test:unit:coverage -w mfe-app-1
